articles.title: Gulf Oil Tankers Near $650,000 a Day as Iran War Disrupts Flows
articles.summary: Earnings for ships on the world’s benchmark oil tanker route approached $650,000 a day as the Iran war and a bold bet by a South Korean tycoon continue to reshape how barrels are transported across the globe.

articles.title: China Ramps Up Credit Support in Overhaul of Property Market

articles.title: Modi Remains India’s Top Choice for Prime Minister, Survey Shows

articles.title: Short Squeeze in US Long Bonds Shows ‘Bessent Put’ at Work
articles.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s surprise plan to tamp down US borrowing costs by expanding bond buybacks may have sparked fierce debate about its ultimate effectiveness, but key market metrics and positioning show that it’s having an impact.

articles.title: US-Canada Cosmetic Tariffs Threaten the $10 Beauty Impulse Buy
articles.summary: In between offering advice on how to find the best towels and where to buy affordable versions of high-end garments, Bryce Gruber recently waded into the US-Canada trade war, warning her social-media followers that some of their favorite makeup is about to get more expensive.

articles.title: Braskem’s $11 Billion Debt Rework Puts Spotlight on Petrobras
articles.summary: Braskem SA’s announcement of an $11 billion debt restructuring staved off an immediate crisis that would have pushed it into bankruptcy protection. But the parties remain far apart on key issues ranging from terms of shareholder support to how existing debt will be reworked.

articles.title: Binance Hires Two Senior Compliance Executives From Crypto.com
articles.summary: Binance Holdings Ltd. has hired two senior compliance executives from Crypto.com as the exchange bolsters ranks in that department after a number of staff departures and ongoing regulatory scrutiny.

articles.title: United Airlines CEO on Expansion Plans, Airfares, Demand
articles.summary: United Airlines Chief Executive Officer Scott Kirby discusses the largest international expansion in the company’s history, the strength he sees in both customer demand and the US economy, and plans to offset increased oil prices. The carrier will now fly to 10 more destinations in Europe and Asia.

articles.title: Guggenheim Investments Says Affiliates May Buy Its Hard-Hit Loan
articles.summary: Guggenheim Investments, the asset-management arm of Mark Walter’s Guggenheim Partners, is telling lenders that affiliates may look to buy portions of a loan issued by its financing entity after the debt’s value collapsed in recent weeks.

articles.title: New Iran Sanctions Part of 'Piecemeal Strategy,' Says Rep. Gabe Amo
articles.summary: Representative Gabe Amo, a Rhode Island Democrat, called the US threat of sanctions against countries doing business with Iran more of the president's "piecemeal strategy" that's leaving the administration "grasping at straws." (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Aston Martin Set to Drop Out of FTSE 250 as Turnaround Splutters
articles.summary: Luxury carmaker Aston Martin Lagonda Global Holdings Plc is set to leave the FTSE 250, a move that would cement its status as a small-cap stock and highlight its faltering turnaround.
